findings.text: Tile cursor shape selector uses six consecutive small integer codes. None is zero, underline is one, lower third is two, lower half is three, two thirds is four, block is five. A cursor descriptor stores one of these codes in its shape field.
Tile map descriptor carries tile width in pixels, tile height in scanlines, per tile colour depth, tile count, and a pointer to packed bitmap data. Packing rounds to whole bytes.

Tiled drawing descriptors use tile-unit geometry. Fill request holds origin, tile extents, tile index, foreground and background colours, and raster operation selector. Area move holds source origin, destination origin, and shared extents. Indexed blit holds origin, extents, colours, tile count, and pointer to index array. Cursor holds position, erase or draw mode, shape code, and colours.

Tile acceleration table offers tile map establishment, rectangular tile move, rectangular tile fill, indexed tile array copy, cursor update, and maximum map length query. All spatial measures after establishment are expressed in tiles, and each drawing entry receives framebuffer context plus its descriptor.

Framebuffer info flag word reserves distinct bits. Disabled is 0x0002. Virtual RAM framebuffer is 0x0004. Partial pan allowed is 0x0040. Fast reads is 0x0080. No acceleration is zero. Copy area is 0x0100. Fill rectangle is 0x0200. Image blit is 0x0400. Rotate is 0x0800. Horizontal pan is 0x1000. Vertical pan is 0x2000. Vertical wrap is 0x4000. Tile blitting is 0x20000. Always set parameters is 0x40000. Foreign endian and big endian math both use 0x100000. Hide shared memory start is 0x200000.

Central framebuffer descriptor groups identity, locking, mode state, colour state, device links, memory mapping, hardware state, and driver private storage. Identity includes reference count, node number, flags, and rotation hint. Mode state includes variable info, fixed info, monitor specs, mode list, current mode, pixmaps, colour map, and blank level. Conditional sections add backlight device with curve lock, LCD link, and deferred IO work state. Links include operation table, parent and device pointers, and optional tile operations. Mapping uses a union of mapped base or system buffer plus size, fake palette, hardware state word, console private area, device dependent area, and two skip hints for virtual terminal switch and panic output.

Hardware state word has two named values: running is zero and suspended is one. Blanking level lives in a separate integer field. Two boolean hints suppress virtual terminal switching across suspend resume and suppress output after panic.

Framebuffer descriptor carries two mutexes with split duties. One guards open, release, and control operations. The other guards memory mapping and shared memory fields. Small inline helpers acquire and release the first mutex for a given descriptor.

Default operation bundles are grouped by memory kind. Input output memory uses port read write, cached fill copy blit, and port mapping. System and DMA memory share system read write with system fill copy blit. Deferred variants wrap read with pass through and wrap write and drawing with a damage callback for range or area, selected per memory kind, plus a deferred mapping entry.

A row padding helper copies a compact source rectangle into a wider destination by copying each row byte by byte then skipping the pitch gap. A device accessor returns the framebuffer device when device support is configured and null otherwise. An LCD accessor returns the stored LCD link. In this fragment the backlight accessor always returns null and the backlight blank notifier does nothing.

Big endian math selection depends on configuration. With foreign endian support it follows a flag bit when both endians are allowed, or a fixed answer when only one foreign endian is configured. Without foreign endian support it follows host byte order. Position and shift helpers consult this predicate to mirror bit placement for acceleration.

Timing selectors use zero for maximum, one for vertical sync, two for horizontal sync, three for dot clock, with monitor ignore at 0x100. Mode origin flags use zero for unknown, one for detailed, two for standard, four for VESA, eight for calculated, sixteen for first, thirty two for derived from variable info. VESA database size is forty three entries and discrete monitor timing size is 0x50.

Video mode entry holds optional name and refresh plus resolution, pixel clock, four margins, two sync lengths, sync flags, video mode flags, and origin flag. Discrete timing wrapper pairs numeric identifiers and codes with a pointer to such an entry. Modelist node links a list head with an embedded mode value.

Framebuffer logging helpers prefix messages with the device node number and delegate to kernel print levels for error, notice, warning, info, debug, once only warning, and once only warning with condition. One variant stringifies its checked expression into the message.
Four headers use include guards that define a private macro on first inclusion to suppress repeat processing.

Open flag validation covers access modes, creation and exclusion, terminal and truncation control, append and nonblocking behavior, sync and data sync, async notification, direct and large file handling, directory and symlink following controls, access time, close on exec, path only, temporary file, and empty path handling. The openat2 variant adds one regular file requirement. Resolve validation covers no cross device, no magic links, no symlinks, beneath, in root, and cached behaviors. A regular internal marker occupies bit thirty. First published open-how size is twenty four bytes and latest equals that version.

Large file forcing is true on platforms without thirty two bit off_t support. Lock command classification abstracts over thirty two and sixty four bit command numbers: one configuration maps the classic commands to the thirty two bit family and the suffixed commands to the sixty four bit family, while the alternate configuration disables the thirty two bit family and maps classic commands to the sixty four bit family. Combined predicates accept either family for get, set, and blocking set.

Compatibility floppy geometry holds size, sector, head, track, and stretch as compat width integers, four one byte timing fields, and a compat address for the name. A thirty two bit compat control code retrieves this structure. Extent mapping progress holds flags, mapped count, capacity, and user pointer to result array start.

Packet filter calling convention aliases argument registers one through five, context to register six, and frame pointer to register ten. Legacy accumulator names map A to zero, X to seven, temporary to two, data to eight, and header length to nine. Extended numbering places parameters at the architectural maximum, accumulator extension one beyond, external maximum two beyond, with just in time maximum equal to external maximum.

Filter immediates reserve tail call at 0xf0, probe memory at 0x20, probe with sign extension at 0x40, thirty two bit probe at 0xa0, atomic probe and call arguments both at 0xe0, thirty two bit sign extending probe and no speculation marker both at 0xc0, symbol type character t, and maximum stack of five hundred twelve bytes.

Instruction constructors build complete operation descriptors from operation, destination, source or immediate, and optional offset. Families cover sixty four and thirty two bit arithmetic with register or immediate sources, endian conversion selected by direction with byte length, byte swap as a fixed direction case, thirty two and sixty four bit moves from register or immediate, and a per CPU address move distinguished by a negative one offset marker.
A small predicate reports whether an instruction is the per CPU address move by requiring both the sixty four bit register move opcode and the reserved negative offset together.

Several fragments invite confusion. Tile callbacks switch from pixels to tile units after map setup. Two framebuffer flag names share one bit value, as do two pairs of filter probe markers. Deferred write must only report damage on positive transfer length, and drawing damage uses destination geometry. Compat floppy name width differs from native pointers.
